reference_policy.secondary_selector: SPECIFIED_BUFF3 interpreted as marked group first, then HATRED_DES4 effective current taunt descending, then stable ID. No finite priority constant. Missing native body: explicitly replaceable preference/fallback policy.
reference_policy.undefined_immunities: Absent m_defined fields are recorded as undefined, not proved false; explicit model defaults use no immunities.
reference_policy.timing: TimeMode0 affectedSlow1: each native windup and full busy duration divided by max(currentASPD,.01), ceil to quantum. Graphic clamp/minimum.01 remain reference policies.
reference_policy.combat: Empace INPUT_TARGET2 uses actual current blocker when blocked and original ranged target when unblocked; only one normal cast at a time. Emppnt src1/time1 uses own selector refreshed at OnAttack and is not forcibly bound to blocker.
reference_policy.projectile_reads: Emppnt useCachedAtkOnly1: source at_cast, target at_hit. Empace0: source/target at_hit; generic retained-source launch snapshot fallback remains explicit reference policy.
reference_policy.threshold: Dynamic current HP / effective standard-layer maxHP <=.5 including equality, restoreDelay0 and toggleOnce0; heal above threshold deactivates, can reactivate. BuffisSilenceable0 means no silence suppression. Boundary reconciliation is reference timing.
reference_policy.combat_settlement: Attempt actual blocker-only combat with settle_blocking True before selection; no initial blocked_by condition prevents first-tick settlement. Invalid blocker produces no target and no ranged fallback after its own live unblocked guard.
